<translate>
The '''Daima Saga''' is one of the two sagas that follow the [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas|story mode]]. It opens, together with the [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]], once you complete every quest of the Buu Saga, and covers Gomah's wish, the three floors of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]], the Tamagamis and King Gomah.
</translate>

<translate>
Quest 3, ''To the Demon Realm'', has Bulma tune your space pod: completing it unlocks the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]] destination in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]] menu. The rest of the saga takes you through the Third, Second and First Demon Worlds, in that order.
</translate>

<translate>
== Notes ==
</translate>
<translate>
* Quest 2 sends you to [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku|Goku]] at Goku's House.
* Quest 3 asks Bulma for 16 Ender Pearls, 8 Crying Obsidian, 8 Blocks of Redstone and 16 Amethyst Shards.
* Quest 15, ''The Great Assault'', is fought against waves of [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah Soldier|Gomah Soldiers]].
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Tamagami Number 3|Tamagami Number 3]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Tamagami Number 2|Tamagami Number 2]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Tamagami Number 1|Tamagami Number 1]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah|Gomah]] also roam the Demon Realm as [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|World Bosses]].
* Completing quest 11, ''Majin Duu Appears'', opens the three Hirudegarn quests of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] (if the GT Saga has not opened them already).
</translate>
